Backups & attachment retention

Workspace backups should include notes, canvases, archived learning materials, and attachments. Archived image references remain protected when source notes are removed.

Provider credentials

Exclude API keys from exported backups.

Local-First Policy

Lumi is designed with privacy at its core. Workspace records are stored locally. Your selected AI provider receives prompts and the context included with each request. Choose a local model to keep model inference on your configured local endpoint.
